taxonomic_note: Current Kew accepts the species and recognizes infraspecific variation.
look_here_first: Start with the leaves: long stiff yucca-like linear leaves with spiny margins, topped by pale greenish-white globose heads. It lacks the vivid purple canopy and broad divided leaves of E. leavenworthii.

project_inclusion.range_basis: Bexar and Gillespie are the two exact project target-zone counties currently locked. Broad Blackland/Edwards regional presence is not converted into a third county.

approval_exception.reason: Learner inclusion is independent from native-range certification.

best_field_traits: no conspicuous purple terminal bract crown
morphology_keys.comparison_training: E. leavenworthii is annual, purple, and broad/divided-leaved; E. yuccifolium is perennial and yucca-leaved.

comparisons.key_distinctions: Perennial yucca-like leaves plus pale globose heads versus annual purple divided-leaf architecture.
